task.description:
Make the PAR-02 integration test self-contained so the first maintenance cycle always has missing future partitions to create. The test is currently fixed to use bpm.store.PLATFORM_INSTANCE_ID and now fails only because the shared database already contains the future partitions from earlier runs, making partitions_created == 0.

Please update tests/integration/par02_partition_catalog_test.zig so it cleans up any existing future partitions for the affected parent tables before calling runMaintenanceCycle(), or otherwise resets the test state so the first cycle creates at least one partition on rerun. Preserve the existing idempotency assertion for the second cycle.

After the change, run zig build, zig build test, zig build test-env-verify, and zig build test-integration-par02. Update the handoff with the result and any remaining issues.
acceptance_criteria: The PAR-02 integration test creates a fresh enough state that result.partitions_created > 0 on the first maintenance run
The idempotency check on the second run still passes
